detailZones.title: Front display surface
detailZones.description: Trace the visible blank display, bezels, mount pieces, cable channel and front wall finish.

detailZones.title: Camera and speaker bar
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible room camera, lens, shutter, mount, soundbar grille, end caps and cable.

detailZones.title: Touch console
detailZones.description: Study the visible tabletop touch console, screen, stand, hinge, base, ports and cable retention.

detailZones.title: Table microphone pods
detailZones.description: Compare the visible microphone pod housings, grilles, buttons, ports, feet, cables and table trough.

detailZones.title: Cable and power hub
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible tabletop power hub, sockets, grommets, cable clips, credenza compute box and outlet.

detailZones.title: Mounting and wall hardware
detailZones.description: Trace the visible camera/display/speaker mounts, blank whiteboard, acoustic panels and glass partition hardware.

detailZones.title: Room furniture and finish
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible table, chairs, casters, carpet, floor cover, glass panel, blind and plant pot.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 video-conferencing-console photograph was inspected at source and output resolution. It retains 144 independently pointable display, camera, speaker, touch-console, microphone, cable, mounting and room-finish parts. Meeting content, people, company identity, network connectivity, recording state, occupancy and hidden wiring were excluded.
